# Pull requests

<!-- Generated from the engine code by `make docs`: do not edit by hand. -->

Pull requests (vouchers, in the original) are permanent upgrades. The shop
sells one per ante, for $10; a new one comes after each boss. Each first
pull request has a follow-up, sold once it was merged.

| Id | Pull request | Effect | Follows | Quip |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `more_workspaces` | More Workspaces | +1 card slot in the shop |  | *Super+5 through Super+9, finally.* |
| `even_more_workspaces` | Even More Workspaces | +1 more card slot in the shop | More Workspaces | *Nobody needs ten workspaces. You do.* |
| `early_bird` | Early Bird | Cards and packs in the shop are 25% off |  | *Bought before the hype.* |
| `lifetime_deal` | Lifetime Deal | Cards and packs in the shop are 50% off | Early Bird | *Pay once. Regret never. Probably.* |
| `compositor_tweaks` | Compositor Tweaks | Editions show up twice as often |  | *decoration { blur = true }* |
| `eye_candy` | Eye Candy | Editions show up four times as often | Compositor Tweaks | *Wobbly everything.* |
| `mirror_list` | Mirror List | Rerolls cost $2 less |  | *reflector --sort rate* |
| `fastest_mirror` | Fastest Mirror | Rerolls cost $2 less again | Mirror List | *Downloads at line speed.* |
| `clipboard_manager` | Clipboard Manager | +1 clipboard slot |  | *Remembers more than one thing.* |
| `insider_access` | Insider Access | Oligarchy cards may show up in coreutils packs | Clipboard Manager | *Elite capital, now in coreutils.* |
| `theme_preview` | Theme Preview | base16 packs always hold the theme of your most played hand |  | *See it before you set it.* |

| `overtime` | Overtime | +1 hand each blind |  | *One more hand. Just one.* |

| `empty_trash` | Empty Trash | +1 more discard each blind | rm -i | *Gone for good. Twice.* |
| `shell_aliases` | Shell Aliases | Commands show up twice as often in the shop |  | *alias ll='ls -la', and friends.* |
| `shell_plugins` | Shell Plugins | Commands show up four times as often in the shop | Shell Aliases | *oh-my-zsh, but tasteful.* |
